tags.name: Vanilla
tags.desc: Ordinary sudoku. No other rules apply

tags.name: Not Sudoku
tags.desc: This puzzle isn't sudoku, and doesn't abide by normal sudoku rules

tags.name: Black Kropki
tags.desc: Digits seperated by a black kropki dot must differ in a 1:2 ratio

tags.name: White Kropki
tags.desc: Digits seperated by a white kropki dot must differ by 1

tags.name: V or X Sums
tags.desc: Digits seperated by a V or X must sum to 5 or 10, respectively

tags.name: Quadruples
tags.desc: Numbers inside a dot between 4 cells indicate digits that must appear in at least one of those 4 cells

tags.name: Counting Circles
tags.desc: A digit inside a circle indicates how many times that digit appears in a circle

tags.name: Killer Cages
tags.desc: Digits inside a cage can't repeat and must sum to the value written on the cage

tags.name: Little Killers
tags.desc: Arrowed numbers outside the grid denote the sum of all cells along the diagonal line they point to

tags.name: Thermometer
tags.desc: Digits on a thermometer must strictly increase from bulb to tip

tags.name: Slow Thermometer
tags.desc: Digits on a thermometer must not decrease from bulb to tip

tags.name: Arrow
tags.desc: The digits on an arrow sum to the value in the attached circle

tags.name: Double Arrow
tags.desc: The digits on two connected circles and the digits on the line between them sum to the same value

tags.name: Renban Line
tags.desc: Digits on a renban line must form a consecutive, non-repeating set in any order

tags.name: German Whisper Line
tags.desc: Adjacent digits on a German whisper line must differ by at least 5

tags.name: Whisper Line
tags.desc: Adjacent digits on a whisper line must differ by at least a given amount

tags.name: Region Sum Line
tags.desc: Region borders divide a region sum line into segments. Each segment's digits must sum to the same value

tags.name: Parity Line
tags.desc: Adjacent digits on a parity line must be odd and even

tags.name: Entropic Line
tags.desc: Any set of 3 adjacent cells on an entropic line must contain a low (123), medium (456), and high (789) digit

tags.name: Modular Line
tags.desc: Any set of 3 adjacent cells on a modular line must have a unique remainder when divided by 3

tags.name: Palindrome Line
tags.desc: The digits on a palindrome line must read the same forwards and backwards

tags.name: Diagonals
tags.desc: A diagonal line going from corner to corner must contain one of every digit

tags.name: Other Line
tags.desc: There's a line that places some kind of restriction on some digits

tags.name: Skyscrapers
tags.desc: Numbers outside the grid indicate how many digits are visible when looking into the grid. Digits block visibility of lower digits behind them

tags.name: Sandwich Sums
tags.desc: Numbers outside the grid indicate the sum of the digits sandwiched between two specific digits (generally 1 and 9)

tags.name: X Sums
tags.desc: Numbers outside the grid indicate the sum of the first X digits, where X is the closest digit inside the grid

tags.name: Modifier Cells
tags.sheet: Modifier Cells (some cells' values differ from their placed digit)
tags.desc: Some cells have a different value than the digit they contain

tags.name: Unusual Digits
tags.sheet: Unusual Digits (eg. not the typical digits 1 to 9, or 1 to 6, etc.)
tags.desc: Puzzle uses different digits than usual, or perhaps even letters

tags.name: Even & Odd
tags.desc: There's a clue that dictates specific cells be even or odd

tags.name: Minimum or Maximum
tags.desc: A gray cell with 4 small arrows is either higher than every neighbor or lower, depending on the arrows' orientation

tags.name: Fog
tags.desc: The grid is partially obscured by fog that clears as digits are placed

tags.name: Anti-Knight
tags.desc: A digit can't be within a chess knight's move of itself

tags.name: Anti-King
tags.desc: A digit can't be within a chess king's move of itself

tags.name: Adjacency Restriction
tags.sheet: Adjacency Restriction (eg. adjacent digits can't sum to 7)
tags.desc: There is some kind of limitation on what digits can go in any two adjacent cells

tags.name: Irregular Sudoku
tags.desc: Regions boundaries are irregularly shaped

tags.name: Chaos Construction
tags.desc: Region boundaries are irregularly shaped and must be deduced by the solver

tags.name: Pathing
tags.desc: The solver must draw a path or loop based on some criteria

tags.name: Shading
tags.desc: The solver must color cells based on some criteria

tags.name: Unique
tags.sheet: Some other unique rule (only select if said rule is major and not similar to any existing tag)
tags.desc: A major component of this puzzle can't be explained with existing tags
